One file compiled for Ethereum and for Base gets each chain's own USDC, WETH, tokenized stocks, protocol contracts (UniswapV3.Factory) and chainId; a name the chain lacks is refused at compile; Base.UniswapV3.Factory is only Base's address, to pass across chains and never to call, and tokens are never qualified. Writing for an EVM chain versus Solana (Account parameters, token accounts, SPL Token transfer and Token-2022 transferChecked for stock mints, --account). Which chains take transactions (Ethereum, Base, Solana; the rest are preview chains) and how to request one. Per chain, its id, slug, native coin, Sauce engine and Kitchen, intents, CCTP domain, tokens and every protocol with its address. Use when the user asks what is on a chain, needs an address, picks a chain, writes one program for several chains or for Solana, a name fails to compile on one chain, or a transaction is refused on a preview chain.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-chains/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":17699},{"path":"examples/chains.mts","bytes":8388},{"path":"examples/holdings.sauce.ts","bytes":1376},{"path":"examples/payout-solana.sauce.ts","bytes":3379}],"references":{"count":45,"some":["references/arbitrum.md","references/arc.md","references/aurora.md","references/avalanche.md","references/base-stocks.md","references/base.md","references/berachain.md","references/blast.md","references/boba.md","references/bsc.md","references/celo.md","references/core.md"],"rest":"every other file is references/<name>.md: sauce_skill with that path, or this skill's SKILL.md, which says how they are named"}},{"name":"sauce-cli","description":"The sauce command line. Transactions are built and sent on Ethereum, Base and Solana, the chains the initial release supports; every other chain is a preview chain, where programs compile and simulate and a transaction is refused with the link to request the chain. Use when asked to compile, simulate, run, execute, test, send or deploy a Sauce program (*.sauce.ts), pass arguments to its main, get its bytecode or unsigned transaction, fund or create a Pot, check what a transaction did, create or use an agent's own wallet and its policy, or when a command refuses a preview chain.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-cli/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":30869},{"path":"examples/buy.sauce.ts","bytes":3208},{"path":"examples/payout.sauce.ts","bytes":1731}]},{"name":"sauce-distributed-swap","description":"Writing a Sauce program that spreads one exact-input swap over several price-limited pools as a limit order, a limit buy that never pays more than a maximum price for any unit, fees included, and never strands input. Use when asked for a distributed, split or multi-venue swap, \"swap across protocols\", \"buy up to a price\", a limit order, a minimum-amount-out or max-average-price check, or one trade routed through several pools.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-distributed-swap/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":30594},{"path":"examples/distributed-swap.mts","bytes":18130},{"path":"examples/distributed-swap.sauce.ts","bytes":7023}]},{"name":"sauce-examples","description":"A cookbook of complete Sauce programs, each run against real contracts before it ships — buying a tokenized stock under a price cap, a dollar-cost-averaging tick, a stop-loss and take-profit on Chainlink's price, an Aave V3 health-factor guard, lending idle USDC above a reserve, a weighted USDC payroll, a two-token rebalance, a read-only price survey run with sauce simulate, a cross-chain cascade that repays a loan on Base from Ethereum and sends the change back, and a Token-2022 stock payment on Solana — on Ethereum, Base and Solana; and an index of every example in the other skills, with the chains it is checked on and the sauce command that runs it. Use when the user says \"show me an example\", \"sample Sauce program\", \"how do I write X in Sauce\", or wants a complete program for a task such as buying a stock, DCA, a limit or stop order, a lending position, payroll, rebalancing, reading prices, a cross-chain intent or a Solana token payment.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-examples/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":29144},{"path":"examples/AaveV3Reads.json","bytes":783},{"path":"examples/aave-health.sauce.ts","bytes":3188},{"path":"examples/buy-stock.sauce.ts","bytes":3744},{"path":"examples/dca.sauce.ts","bytes":2820},{"path":"examples/eth-prices.sauce.ts","bytes":3103},{"path":"examples/pay-stock.sauce.ts","bytes":2823},{"path":"examples/payroll.sauce.ts","bytes":2227},{"path":"examples/rebalance.sauce.ts","bytes":4538},{"path":"examples/repay-on-base.sauce.ts","bytes":3705},{"path":"examples/stop-loss.sauce.ts","bytes":3760},{"path":"examples/supply-idle.sauce.ts","bytes":2215}]},{"name":"sauce-globals","description":"The names a Sauce program uses without any import, and how they resolve on the chain it is compiled for — token symbols (USDC, USDT, WETH, …) and tokenized stocks (SPCXc, TSLAon, TSLAx, NVDA_US, SPACEX, …, on Ethereum, Base and Solana), Token(address) and a bound const t = Token(x), the token methods .transfer/.approve/.transferFrom/.balanceOf with SafeERC20 behaviour and USDT, the @sauce/token functions, protocol namespaces (UniswapV3.Factory, UniswapV4.StateView, AaveV3.Pool, …) and family aliases, available(...) for a venue a chain may lack, the Namespace_Contract compile-time defines, chain names, chainId and ctx.*. Links generated indexes of every token, protocol contract and chain, the same lists sauce globals prints. Use when writing any Sauce program that moves tokens, calls a protocol or names a chain, when checking whether a name exists on a chain, or when a name does not resolve (\"is not a declared variable\", \"ambiguous\", \"is not deployed\").","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-globals/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":14715},{"path":"examples/globals.mts","bytes":4346},{"path":"examples/globals.sauce.ts","bytes":2393},{"path":"references/chains.md","bytes":2859},{"path":"references/protocols.md","bytes":36793},{"path":"references/stocks.md","bytes":239047},{"path":"references/tokens.md","bytes":4428}]},{"name":"sauce-intents","description":"Cross-chain intents written in Sauce — a file that opens the intent, Base(() => { ... }).reward({ ... }) in main, its inputs main's parameters passed with --args; how an intent is published, funded, discovered, filled, proven, claimed, cancelled and refunded (a sauce intent command each) (the intent hash, the per-intent vault, IntentPublished and IntentFunded, isIntentFunded); every way to publish and fund it (sauce intent publish from a wallet, sauce run from a Pot, a transfer into the vault then publish, cascade children, quoted intents); amounts measured on chain; token-only bodies versus program bodies; the delivery; on which chain each name resolves; the shared destination Pot and the Kitchen fee the solver pays; rehearsing both sides; and the deadline and creator every intent needs. Use when a program should continue on another chain, forward a swap or bridge output, build a cascade, pay a solver, or when the user mentions intents, rewards, vaults, solvers, Portals, provers, Executors or Pots.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-intents/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":36581},{"path":"examples/cross-chain.sauce.ts","bytes":1945},{"path":"examples/fund-by-transfer.sauce.ts","bytes":2683},{"path":"examples/intents.mts","bytes":16719},{"path":"examples/swap-on-base.sauce.ts","bytes":7038},{"path":"references/portal.md","bytes":7930}]},{"name":"sauce-overview","description":"Start here for any Sauce task — what Sauce is (a programmable-transaction runtime whose programs, written in SauceScript as .sauce.ts files, run atomically on EVM chains and Solana), what a Pot, a cook and the Kitchen are and who may do what with each, the path from a program file to an executed transaction with the sauce command, the rules every program follows, and a map of every Sauce skill (what each teaches and holds, when to load it rather than its neighbour, the skills to read in order for common tasks, and how to read them over MCP). Use when the user mentions Sauce, SauceScript, a .sauce or .sauce.ts file, @eco-incorp/sauce, the sauce command, a Pot, Kitchen, cook or engine, Eco intents, or asks to \"write a Sauce program\", \"do this atomically on chain\", or \"swap/bridge/lend with Sauce\".","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-overview/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":26081}]},{"name":"sauce-protocols","description":"Every DeFi protocol a Sauce program can call, from the SDK's registry — an index by category with how to choose between them (a lending market versus another, a concentrated-liquidity pool versus a V2 pair or a stable pool, an aggregator, a bridge), a registry file per protocol (its deployments on every chain, how a program names each contract there, its ABI functions), and a document per protocol (what it is for, its pitfalls, a compiled example, its templates and notes). Covers every protocol as a registry namespace (deployed contracts, address-only contracts, interfaces called with an address), available(...) for a chain that may lack one, ABI imports for unrecorded contracts, factories and pool lookups, and checking a recorded address has code. Use when a program must call a protocol (PancakeSwap V3, Aerodrome Slipstream, Curve, Balancer, Camelot, Lido, …), when the user asks which protocols or pools exist on a chain or which to use, needs a factory or router address, or wants a protocol's pitfalls.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-protocols/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":7800},{"path":"examples/protocols.mts","bytes":3381},{"path":"examples/protocols.sauce.ts","bytes":1354}],"references":{"count":270,"some":["references/aave-v2.md","references/aave-v3.md","references/aave-v4.md","references/abracadabra.md","references/across.md","references/aerodrome-slipstream.md","references/aerodrome.md","references/aevo.md","references/alchemix.md","references/ambient.md","references/arbitrum-bridge.md","references/arrakis.md"],"rest":"every other file is references/<name>.md: sauce_skill with that path, or this skill's SKILL.md, which says how they are named"}},{"name":"sauce-script","description":"Writing SauceScript programs (.sauce.ts files) — the checked TypeScript subset Sauce compiles to on-chain bytecode, with a complete reference of its types, operators, statements and builtins (ctx, crypto, Math, abi, evm, svm, value methods, account properties, contract bindings, limits). Covers the two program forms (function main(...), whose parameters are every input a program takes, intent files included, and a file of top-level statements for a program with no inputs), what compiling a file for a chain adds (its names and token syntax, the source otherwise as written), module constants, helper functions, what syntax compiles and what to write instead, require/throw and atomic failure, catching a failed external call, and reading compile errors. Use when writing or editing any Sauce program, when a Sauce compile fails (\"unsupported construct\", \"is not a declared variable\", \"expected a number, found a bool\", \"Unexpected token\"), or when asked what SauceScript can or cannot express.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-script/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":24965},{"path":"examples/IOracle.json","bytes":308},{"path":"examples/saucescript.mts","bytes":5716},{"path":"examples/twap.sauce.ts","bytes":1553},{"path":"references/builtins.json","bytes":30657},{"path":"references/builtins.md","bytes":45605}]},{"name":"sauce-solana-distributed-swap","description":"Writing a Sauce program for Solana that spreads one exact-input swap over several price-limited pools as a limit order, never paying more than a maximum price for any unit, fees included, and never stranding input. Covers the rules (skip a missing, empty, paused or past-limit pool, a fee-adjusted limit per pool, minimum and average-price checks, refund only the unspent budget), pools found before the cook and passed as accounts, a venue read from its pool's owner, the nine-account slot per pool, every venue whose swap takes a price limit (Raydium CLMM, PancakeSwap CLMM, Byreal, Stabble CLMM, Orca Whirlpools, Cropper, DefiTuna, Crema, Phoenix) and those left out, a complete program over four pools, maxPrice, minTokens and maxAvgPrice for tokens of any decimals, compute units, accounts, lookup tables and running it. Use when asked for a distributed, split or multi-venue swap on Solana, \"swap across Raydium and Orca\", \"buy SOL up to a price\", a limit order, or one trade routed through several Solana pools.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-solana-distributed-swap/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":35647},{"path":"examples/solana-distributed-swap.mts","bytes":9088},{"path":"examples/solana-distributed-swap.sauce.ts","bytes":16607},{"path":"references/venues.md","bytes":9877}]},{"name":"sauce-solana","description":"Writing and running Sauce programs on Solana (the SVM target) — declaring every account as an Account parameter with Writable/Signer roles, the account manifest the compile returns, passing accounts by name with --account, the @sauce/token arm for SPL Token and Token-2022 (balanceOf and the other reads, transferChecked and approveChecked for either program, the legacy transfer and approve) and what Token-2022's extensions do to a program (transfer fees, scaled UI amounts, pauses, frozen accounts, transfer hooks), svm.call CPIs and svm.sload byte reads, account .owner and .dataLen checks, a 32-byte key as an Address argument, runtime arguments without Account slots, and how a program runs with sauce run --chain solana, through the Kitchen on the owner's Pot or directly on the engine (--via engine). Use when the user targets Solana, SPL tokens, Token-2022, PYUSD or tokenized stocks on Solana, PDAs or CPIs, account manifests, lamport fees, CPI depth, LiteSVM, or Solana venues such as Raydium, Orca or Meteora.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-solana/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":22915},{"path":"examples/solana.mts","bytes":7406},{"path":"examples/solana.sauce.ts","bytes":2178},{"path":"examples/token-2022.sauce.ts","bytes":2116}]},{"name":"sauce-swaps","description":"Swapping inside a Sauce program with @sauce/router — one function per venue (uniswapV2, uniswapV3, uniswapV4, curve, balancerV2, dodoV2, traderJoeLB, woofi, maverickV2, and the try forms), every argument a run-time value, each returning what the recipient received and reverting below minOut; which venues are paid first and which call back through the Pot's Router, which pool families the Router's callbacks service (Uniswap V3 and forks, PancakeSwap V3, Algebra, Synthra, UnitFlow, Uniswap V4), exact input only, how a price limit produces a partial fill, the PancakeSwap Infinity entry points on the Router itself, and the guard that stops a leg from stranding input. Use when the user wants a swap, trade, price limit, sqrtPriceLimitX96, min-out or slippage bound, a partial fill, \"swap then …\", or asks which venues Sauce can swap on.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-swaps/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":14344},{"path":"examples/swap-leg.sauce.ts","bytes":2518},{"path":"examples/swaps.mts","bytes":5738}]},{"name":"sauce-typescript","description":"The TypeScript side of Sauce (@eco-incorp/sauce) — compiling a .sauce.ts program for a chain from application code exactly as the sauce command does, encoding its main(...) arguments and the Pot.cook transaction, deriving and deploying the owner's Pot, the raw compiler and compact arguments, JSON action programs, settlement verification, browser compilation with ready(), and the rule that the package embeds no RPC. Use when writing application or script code that compiles, encodes, verifies or submits Sauce programs, or when the user asks which import or subpath to use.","uri":"sauce://skills/sauce-typescript/SKILL.md","files":[{"path":"SKILL.md","bytes":12994},{"path":"examples/actions.mts","bytes":4090},{"path":"examples/compiler.mts","bytes":2966},{"path":"examples/cook.mts","bytes":3449},{"path":"examples/verify.mts","bytes":4627}]}]}
